title: 法羅礦復育工程
subcategoryTitle: 礦山復育與長期水管理
subcategoryTitleEn: Mine rehabilitation and long-term water management
summary: 以大規模廢礦、尾礦與污染水治理為例，建立水量、物質負荷及土地回復表。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: A large abandoned-mine, tailings and contaminated-water case builds water, mass-load and land-recovery records. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 廢石與尾礦分區的事件集水；濃度下降但雨季負荷上升的判讀；水相金屬到污泥的質量去向
v31FocusEn: Event catchment water across waste-rock and tailings zones; Interpreting lower concentration with greater wet-season load; Metal transfer from water to sludge

steps.title: 廢石與尾礦分區的事件集水：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Event catchment water across waste-rock and tailings zones: mechanism and resource flow

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Event catchment water across waste-rock and tailings zones” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Faro Mine remediation”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「法羅礦復育工程」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「廢石與尾礦分區的事件集水」。集水面積以公頃、雨量以毫米時，乘以十可得到立方公尺，再以逕流係數估計事件逕流體積。這不是洪峰流量公式，不能直接決定排水渠尺寸；需另處理降雨歷線、入滲、滯洪與流路。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Faro Mine remediation as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses event catchment water across waste-rock and tailings zones. With area in hectares and rainfall in millimetres, multiplying by ten gives cubic metres; a runoff coefficient estimates event volume. This is not a peak-flow formula and cannot size a channel without storm timing, infiltration, storage and routing. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 廢石與尾礦分區的事件集水：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「廢石與尾礦分區的事件集水」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Event catchment water across waste-rock and tailings zones” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：V = A·P·c·10；代入 A = 80 ha、P = 45 mm/event、c = 0.6 runoff fraction，得 21,600 m³/event（集水面積與雨量體積的合成教學算例；輸入單位：A: ha; P: mm/event; c: runoff fraction。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 P 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: V = A·P·c·10; with A = 80 ha, P = 45 mm/event, c = 0.6 runoff fraction the result is 21,600 m³/event (synthetic teaching example for catchment rainfall volume; input units: A: ha; P: mm/event; c: runoff fraction. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise P by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising P by 10% changes the result to 23,760 m³/event (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 21,600 m³/event（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 P 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 21,600 m³/event (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in P with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「廢石與尾礦分區的事件集水」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「廢石與尾礦分區的事件集水」，對合成暴雨事件畫出降雨、逕流與貯留體積，確認面積單位；以不同逕流係數給出區間而非單一保證值。

Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.

For event catchment water across waste-rock and tailings zones, plot synthetic storm rainfall, runoff and stored volume, checking area units and reporting a range of runoff coefficients rather than one guaranteed value.

knowledge.text: 在「濃度下降但雨季負荷上升的判讀」情境，暴雨時濃度下降但總負荷增加，可能是流量大幅上升；只看濃度圖會把污染增加誤判成改善。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。
knowledge.textEn: In the scenario of interpreting lower concentration with greater wet-season load, storm concentration can fall while total load rises because flow increases sharply; concentration-only plots can mistake greater pollution for improvement. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
